Key.note: KEY_TERMS gives คำอธิบายสัญลักษณ์ for 'Map key', but every longer word ran into the first symbol of the key; ป้าย ('labels') was the only short word that fits. A reviewer may prefer to move the key's symbols and use คำอธิบาย.
